settings.title: Do I need an account to ask a question?

settings.editor: A basic service enquiry can be submitted without an account. Private records require a verified account.

settings.title: Can the team guarantee claim approval?

settings.editor: No approval is guaranteed. Assessment and decisions remain with the insurer.

settings.title: Is medical history required to register?

settings.editor: No. Profile and medical-history fields are optional.

settings.title: How do I check the current service fees?

settings.editor: Ask the team to explain the approved fee policy before proceeding.
